how_made: Language, class and kind were fixed for every slot by a seeded shuffle before writing. The author read one excerpt per document and wrote each pair by hand to its slot; no pair was generated by a script or a template. Pair ids were assigned by a seeded shuffle so that order carries no label. The rule is authoring-spec.md. After writing, short none and contradicts pairs and a few supports pairs were lengthened so that statement length does not predict the class: a grounded side took a further detail of the same fact from the same document, a written side a detail from the author's general knowledge; no label, language or kind changed and no reader or model had seen the set.
